DECLARE @Datetoprocess DATE
SET @Datetoprocess = '2023-09-01';

	SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT WHERE DEP_Account_Status <> 'C' AND AS_OF_DATE = CAST(@Datetoprocess AS DATE) -- DAILY LOAD
	UNION ALL
	SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EDS.Deposit_Fact_Closed_VW WHERE DATEPART(mm,ACCT_CLS_DATE) =  DATEPART(mm,@Datetoprocess) -- CLOSE LOAD
--1645474


DECLARE @Datetoprocess DATE
SET @Datetoprocess = '2023-09-01';


WITH DEPOSIT_FACT AS (
	SELECT * FROM EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT WHERE DEP_Account_Status <> 'C' AND AS_OF_DATE = CAST(@Datetoprocess AS DATE) -- DAILY LOAD
	UNION ALL
	SELECT * FROM EDS.Deposit_Fact_Closed_VW WHERE DATEPART(mm,ACCT_CLS_DATE) =  DATEPART(mm,@Datetoprocess) -- CLOSE LOAD
)


SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM EDS.DATE_DIM EDD
INNER JOIN (SELECT DateSk, FullDate, Previous_Business_Day, Month_End
FROM EDS.DATE_DIM DD
WHERE DD.FULLDATE = CAST(@Datetoprocess AS DATE)) EEC 
ON EDD.FullDate = EEC.FullDate
INNER JOIN EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP EDA
ON EDA.AS_OF_DATE = EDD.FULLDATE
LEFT JOIN DEPOSIT_FACT EDF
	ON EDA.ACID = EDF.GAM_ACID
	AND EDA.BANK_ID = EDF.GAM_BANK_ID
	AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE = EDF.AS_OF_DATE
